title: HP 21W Gulf Front Condo - Vacation Rental in High Pointe Resort,FL | 30a Escapes
description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES presents... "HP 21W Gulf Front Condo”at High Pointe Resort in Seacrest Beach! Start your day with stunning wraparound Gulf views from your private corner oasis. Lounge by the resort-like pool, unwind in the hot tub, or take a short stroll to your private beach access. Nestled perfectly between Rosemary and Alys Beach, this condo combines luxury, relaxation, and coastal charm. Enjoy nearby dining, boutiques, and endless sunsets. The perfect getaway with family or friends awaits. Learn more below...*** HIGHLIGHTS**Wrap-Around Gulf Views from a Luxurious Corner Unit – Wake up to breathtaking, panoramic views of the Gulf in a stunning, sunlit corner retreat.Large Community Pool, Hot Tub & Private Beach Access – Relax, unwind, and soak up the ultimate beachfront vibe with exclusive access to resort-style amenities.Chef’s Kitchen with Premium Appliances – Cook like a pro in a modern, fully-equipped kitchen designed for gourmet meals and unforgettable dining experiences.Steps from Rosemary Beach & Alys Beach – Immerse yourself in the charm of nearby iconic beach towns, perfect for boutique shopping, dining, and exploring.Spacious Balcony for Outdoor Dining – Enjoy al fresco meals or wind down with a drink as the sun sets over the water.Pickleball Courts & On-Site Beachfront Dining at Crabby Steve’s – Stay active with fun games, then indulge in delicious food just steps from the waves.*** LIVING AREA ***The open-concept living area is a sanctuary of relaxation and togetherness, boasting floor-to-ceiling windows that frame stunning, panoramic Gulf views. Step out onto the expansive balcony to immerse yourself in the refreshing sea breeze and take in the endless, awe-inspiring scenery.Spacious open-concept living area featuring luxurious plush seating and a state-of-the-art Smart TVBreathtaking panoramic Gulf views framed by stunning floor-to-ceiling windowsEffortless indoor-outdoor living with direct access to a private balcony with plenty of seats*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***The fully renovated chef’s kitchen boasts top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, expansive quartz countertops, and a stylish breakfast bar, combining elegance with functionality. The adjoining dining area, designed to comfortably seat six, offers the perfect setting for memorable meals while enjoying breathtaking views.State-of-the-art premium appliances and expansive counter space, perfect for cooking and entertainingElegant dining table with comfortable seating for 8, ideal for family meals or gatheringsStylish breakfast bar with seating for 3, offering a cozy spot for casual dining or morning coffeeConvenient stack washer and dryer in the unit, making laundry a breeze*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***Provides exquisite accommodations for up to 7 guests, boasting beautifully designed bedrooms with plush furnishings and spa-inspired bathrooms that offer the perfect blend of luxury and tranquility for an unparalleled relaxation experience.Primary King Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.King Guest Suite: King Bed, flat-screen TV, Gulf-front balcony access and En-suite with dual vanities and walk-in shower.Queen Guest Suite: Queen Bed, Twin Bed, flat-screen TV and En-suite with single vanity, shower/tub combo and secondary hall acess.*** HIGH POINTE RESORT OVERVIEW ***Escape to High Pointe Resort, where relaxation meets luxury. Dive into a stunning community pool, soak in the hot tub, or stroll along the private beach access for breathtaking ocean views. Savor delicious beachfront dining at the renowned Crabby Steve’s or challenge friends to a game of pickleball on one of four state-of-the-art courts. Your perfect getaway awaits!Exclusive Gulf Side Resort in a Gated Community in Seacrest Beach.Expansive Pool Deck Featuring a large tropical Pool, Serene Waterfall, Kiddie Pool, and Relaxing Hot TubBeach Front Bar and Grill – Crabby Steve’s, Serving Delicious Meals with Stunning Ocean ViewsExclusive Private Beach Boardwalk for Convenience and PrivacyAmenity-rich 15-Acre Tropical Paradise Perfect for Families and Beach EnthusiastsWell-Maintained Tennis Court and Four Pickleball Courts for Sports LoversChildren's Playground for the Little OnesShuffleboard Court for Family FunBBQ Grills - Charcoal for Outdoor Dining*** LOCATION & COMMUNITY ***Situated between Rosemary Beach and Alys Beach, this condo puts you in the heart of 30A’s best attractions. Walk or bike to local hotspots like Pescados, Havana Beach, and George’s at Alys Beach.Peddlers Pavilion (Right Across the Street) – A lively gathering place, offering a diverse selection of vendors that appeal to both locals and tourists, complemented by live music on most summer evenings.Rosemary Beach (6 min walk) – Cobblestone streets, boutique shops, and a relaxed vibe.Alys Beach (0.9 mile) – Elegant architecture and serene atmosphere.Carillon Downtown & Market Street (8-minute drive) – a vibrant hub for shopping and dining.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW ***Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independentlyWe DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment.Bicycle rentals are available for an additional fee and managed by La Dolce Vita.LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest (including High Pointe), or Alys Beach.High Pointe HOA does not allow unregistered guests or visitors on-site.*** YOUR STAY - OUR PRIORITY ***At 30A Escapes, we’re committed to providing a luxurious, safe, and stress-free vacation experience. Enjoy 24/7 support and an immaculate home designed for comfort and relaxation.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 219638
